entries.There are rumors of undead attacks on th: There are rumours of undead attacks on the eastern border of Wesnoth. You, an officer in the Royal Army, have been sent to the eastern front to protect the villagers and find out what is happening.
entries.Complete <i>Eleventh Hour</i> with no re: Complete Eleventh Hour with no recalling and no reusable items.
entries.When the king received news of the probl: When the king received news of the problem, his adviser Dacyn had much to say. Apparently, these attacks bore much similarity to ones that had previously occurred on the far southern border where undead had been the eventual culprit. Dacyn outlined a plan to combat these intrusions.
entries.You have not yet seen even one-hundredth: You have not yet seen even one-hundredth of the undead armies. This outpost is already lost. Your death — as heroic as I am sure it would be — will benefit no-one. Now come, there is little time to spare.
entries.I recognize the enchantment on that quiv: I recognize the enchantment on that quiver. How did trolls come to possess such an artefact?
entries.I have found your hiding spot, fleshbag!: I have found your hiding spot, flesh-bag! Prepare to die!
entries.Skrai, no!! Cursed Wesnothians, he was m: Skrai, no! Cursed Wesnothians, he was my precious little brother...
entries.Kala, no!! Curse you Wesnothians! You ma: Kala, no! Curse you Wesnothians! You may have killed my sister, but I will chase you east and take my revenge!
entries.Gweddry and Dacyn found but scant respit: Gweddry and Dacyn found but scant respite through the west pass. After weeks of slow and laboured mountain marching, they stumbled upon a green valley and an unknown forest.
entries.Move any unit to the signpost in the nor: Move any unit to the signpost in the north-west
entries.Greetings, travelers! I hope you find ou: Greetings, travellers! I hope you find our forest hospitable.
entries.Bloodshed, hahaha! Nafga will kill the h: Bloodshed, ha ha ha! Nafga will kill the humans and keep the bounty all for himself!
entries.Pursued by a vengeful Mal-Skraat and his: Pursued by a vengeful Mal-Skraat and his minions, Gweddry and Dacyn were forced eastwards out of the Estmarks, into the near reaches of the uncharted Bitter Swamp.
entries.We have already marched much too far eas: We have already marched much too far eastwards. We should now head north-west and try to reach Wesnoth’s northern river outpost. Owaec’s soldiers have likely been routed or killed, but the outpost itself will still provide a place to regroup.
entries.And <i>I’m</i> telling <i>you</i>, you’r: And I’m telling you, you’re going to get us killed wandering around these north-lands! I haven’t seen home in years! Your ‘easy money’ expedition has already led us far-too-far astray from the dunes.
entries.Thanks to my cure made from this marvelo: Thanks to my cure made from this marvellous herb, she is now immune to the swamp’s ill humours! With more, I can make an anti-toxin strong enough to cure the draught of death itself!
I’ve found a sprig of alswdan and am now: I’ve found a sprig of alswdan and am now immune to the swamp’s poison! We only need one more (and $gold_cost gold) to travel east.
I’ve found a sprig of alswdan and am now immune to the swamp’s poison! We’ll need $herbs_needed more (and $gold_cost gold) to travel east.
female^I’ve found a sprig of alswdan and: I’ve found a sprig of alswdan and am now immune to the swamp’s poison! We only need one more (and $gold_cost gold) to travel east.
female^I’ve found a sprig of alswdan and am now immune to the swamp’s poison! We’ll need $herbs_needed more (and $gold_cost gold) to travel east.
entries.female^I’ve found a sprig of alswdan and: I’ve found a sprig of alswdan and am now immune to the swamp’s poison!
entries.Give Hahid nothing; return westward towa: Give Hahid nothing; return westwards towards Wesnoth. (normal)
entries.What the-? You’re serious!? Well, forget: What the–? You’re serious?! Well, forget herbalism, I need to find out more about this mystical land where men pay thrice what they owe!
entries.The dunefolk are leaving and without the: The dunefolk are leaving and without their aid we have no chance of even finding the undead capital. We must defeat Mal-Skraat and proceed westwards.
The swamp’s vapours are overwhelming us... despite our precautions...
entries.Gweddry marched his band of soldiers eve: Gweddry marched his band of soldiers ever eastwards, deeper and deeper into the bogs. A great wall of stone loomed before them.
entries.It is a sad tale. My allies and I were q: It is a sad tale. My allies and I were on a quest when we were ambushed and captured by ghostly warriors. Their leader has been toying with us, forcing us to fight for their amusement.
entries.Bah, I didn’t need your help! Sooner or: Bah, I didn’t need your help! Sooner or later, I would have got out of this cage on my own.
entries.Truly you are heroes of legend to have f: Truly you are heroes of legend to have fought so deep past the undead! I am for ever in your debt.
entries.Silly fleshbags, did you come just to no: Silly flesh-bags, did you come just to nourish our swamp?
entries.Leaving the Bitter Swamp far behind, Gwe: Leaving the Bitter Swamp far behind, Gweddry and his men fled north-west as if their heels were winged. After weeks of frantic marching, they were greatly relieved to see the walls of the northern outpost silhouetted against the horizon...
entries.Did you expect anything else? Owaec has: Did you expect anything else? Owaec has either fled or perished and the undead hordes now march towards the River Weldyn. They must seek to overrun Wesnoth before the king can muster his armies.
entries.Many of these farmers dug deep cellars c: Many of these farmers dug deep cellars connected to a network of caves. I hid as many villagers as I could once our scouts spotted the undead. They must have thought the villages abandoned, for they moved on swiftly westwards, and yet...
entries.... I was not able to save everyone. Gwe: ... I was not able to save everyone. Gweddry, their deaths weigh heavily on my heart.
entries.If the situation is so dire, I am honor-: If the situation is so dire, I am honour-bound to join you... but I know of no way to remove these bandits.
entries.You forget that I have many skills as th: You forget that I have many skills as the adviser to the Crown. I can reveal the bandits when our soldiers enter a village. However, this magic will require my full attention. I will not be able to combat them directly.
entries.Naw, wizard, you go help fight. We don’t: Naw, wizard, you go and help fight. We don’t need no fancy magic for this. I’ve dealt with plenty o’ thugs before. Maybe if you untie me I’ll help you find ’em, eh?
entries.Huzzah!! At last, these villagers are li: Huzzah! At last, these villagers are liberated! Gweddry, thank you for your aid. I place my Clansmen and myself at your service.
entries.Huzzah!! May these be the first of many: Huzzah! May these be the first of many undead to fall before our hooves! Gweddry, thank you for your aid. I place my Clansmen and myself at your service.
entries.The King endeavoured to seek this peerle: The King endeavoured to seek this peerless savant. In all the land, there were two magi that clearly stood out from the rest. Myself, and my good friend Ravan, a mage from the east. The King, wishing to choose the best adviser, sent us both before Eryssa. Then he conversed with the seer privately. None know what was said, but when he came out he announced that the seer was dead, and she had... chosen... me as the King’s new adviser.
entries.As it has now, to finally fulfill the pr: As it has now, to finally fulfil the prophecy that the Sylph spoke of all those years ago.
entries.Since we have failed to root out the ban: Since we have failed to root out the bandit leader, I am honour-bound to stay and defend these villagers! If you wish to go, then go, but I shall not aid you.
entries.We have done well to avoid conflict with: We have done well to avoid conflict with the undead thus far. It is time to turn northwards, towards our goal.
entries.Hahahaha! This dwarf is too short to kee: Ha ha ha ha! This dwarf is too short to keep his head out of the water. I wonder how long he’ll last?
entries.If we intend to save Wesnoth, we must pr: If we intend to save Wesnoth, we must press onwards into the mountains. Let us be off.
entries.Are you our reinforcements? Weldyn promi: Are you our reinforcements? Weldyn promised us aid days ago! The undead already control most of the city. We’re hiding our wounded in the temple, but if we lose the western quarter as well, I fear that no-one will escape.
entries.Intruders... living men... from the sout: Intruders... living men... from the south-east...
entries.I should put you out of your misery righ: I should put you out of your misery right now, but then again, I wanted you to see the results of all my long years of research. I suppose it can wait a little longer.
entries.Yannic?! Well met friend, I haven’t seen: Yannic?! Well met friend, I haven’t seen you in years! Ha, you never could stay out of trouble! How’s your horse, Clansman?
entries.Speaking of help, we require yours. I, t: Speaking of help, we require yours. I, the King’s High Adviser, seek a powerful magic east of the Listra to destroy these undead. We will require your men and provisions for the journey.
entries.Gah! Raa! Get out of my way!!: Gah! Raa! Get out of my way!
entries.Our thanks! You are a fair rider, yet yo: Our thanks! You are a fair rider, yet you bring a foul boon. I will not wield such a dark artefact, though I shall not begrudge its use by my companions.
entries.The next 4 scenarios have 100% gold carr: The next 4 scenarios have 100% gold carry-over, but few villages and 0 starting gold.
entries.Hail, honorable dwarves! Winter comes fa: Hail, honourable dwarves! Winter comes fast on our heels and we seek provisions and supplies for our holy journey. Can you be of aid?
entries.Nay, these humans be good folk! Ye can t: Nay, these humans be good folk! Ye can trust us to help against them orcs. All we be askin’ be some food and drink to re-provision.
entries.Can we not work together, for our mutual: Can we not work together, for our mutual benefit? All we ask is some food and drink to re-provision.
entries.Hsss... orcsss, dwarvesss, humansss. We: Hsss... orcsss, dwarvesss, humansss. We have travelled far to find thisss warmth. I have called the vote; the clutch has ssspoken. These waters are only for Naga. Leave usss be.
entries.Gweddry, we will have to reprovision des: Gweddry, we will have to re-provision despite this conflict. If we spend cautiously and control enough farms, we should be able to gather enough supplies to see us through the winter.
entries.... I have held my tongue long enough. W: ... I have held my tongue long enough. While Wesnoth bleeds, the High Adviser leads us north to forage for food. And as our men and our people die, we seek an unknown mage hovel with some unknown power that the High Adviser has yet to explain more about. Gweddry, surely you feel this is strange?
entries.I have smote many evil orcs in my day, y: I have smote many evil orcs in my day, yet I have known some to show as much honour as any knight. Can we not resolve this peacefully?
entries.The only honor here belongs to the Chief: The only honour here belongs to the Chief!
entries.Let us forge onward. We have almost reac: Let us forge onwards. We have almost reached our destination, and will soon have the power to save Wesnoth from Mal-Ravanal.
entries.Bah, a Clansman never succumbs to despai: Bah, a Clansman never succumbs to despair! Let us press forth and fight to save our homeland, whatever the odds!
entries.Doubtful, but <i>our</i> victory is clos: Doubtful, but our victory is close. Across this river lies the abandoned sanctuary, and within lies an artefact that can destroy Mal-Ravanal once and for all. That is the object of our quest.
entries.This area was deserted whence last I cam: This area was deserted whence last I came, but I have heard rumours that a flight of drakes has taken up residence.
entries.(This and the next 3 scenarios have 100%: (This and the next 3 scenarios have 100% carry-over, but few villages and 0 starting gold.)
entries.No, wait, we just want to-: No, wait, we just want to–
entries.I am Aspirant.\nYet in these northlands,:
I am Aspirant.
Yet in these north-lands, even prey bares its fangs,
And threatens to vanquish us.
We have struggled against mightier flights,
And tarnished our honour.
Yet our flame still persists.
I shall not fall here.
entries.It is here that I seek Iliah-Malal’s Amu:
It is here that I seek Iliah-Malal’s Amulet of the Veil, an artefact possessing the power to open gates between the land of the living and that of the dead.

I once thought such a power too dangerous to use; I am no longer so naive.
entries.All this time... all this time I thought: All this time... all this time I thought we were on a quest towards a noble goal. Searching for a legendary sword, an ancient tome, a holy relic.
entries.Instead, our quest brings us to the lair: Instead, our quest brings us to the lair of a necromancer?! How can you possibly mean to make use of anything ever possessed by such an evil? As soldiers of Wesnoth we are honour-bound to fight for the Light, not the darkness!
entries.Do not be so shortsighted. With the powe: Do not be so short-sighted. With the power to open portals to the Land of the Dead, I can pull Mal-Ravanal’s spirit out of this world. Then, the spells granting false life to the dead will fail, and their fearsome armies will collapse into piles of bones. I am wielding this power for the good of Irdya, not for your honour’s sake.
entries.Dacyn, I am uneasy about this course of: Dacyn, I am uneasy about this course of action. I know little of the Land of the Dead, but everything I have heard suggests–
entries.You would violate the dead’s eternal pea: You would violate the dead’s eternal peace to fight a war, yet you call me short-sighted?! And while our homeland bleeds, you have the gall to speak of the good of all life?! Madness! As a mage of the Light, you should know better!
entries.Unlike you, I have the knowledge and pow: Unlike you, I have the knowledge and power to defeat the undead, and I intend to use it to destroy Mal-Ravanal. Will you wallow in your short-sightedness, or do you intend to help me safeguard all that lives?
entries.By the Clans, I will not!! Would that I: By the Clans, I will not! Would that I had perished in battle against the undead! Better that than living to see Wesnoth’s high mage succumb to the temptation of darkness.
entries.Ugh, spellcasting always gives me the sh: Ugh, spell-casting always gives me the shivers. There’s a reason the more civilized people of my homeland don’t trifle with magic!
entries.This antechamber only has room for eight: This antechamber only has room for eight. I must go to retrieve the artefact, and Gweddry has agreed to accompany me, so that leaves room for six more.
entries.What’s this? Looks like a book on necrom: What’s this? Looks like a book on necromancy? ‘To become a lich, one must first–
entries.<i>Journal of Ravan — 5 Bleeding Moon, 5: Journal of Ravan — 5 Bleeding Moon, 597 YW. Nothing is going well. My research has come to a dead end and even the spirits from the other plane no longer speak to me. I can no longer rely on Dacyn either. That stupid man! He decided that playing politics would be a better use of his abilities than helping me decipher this crucial puzzle. As if he could do any good, being the adviser to that half-decrepit old King Haldric. Then again, maybe that is the game Dacyn wants to play. What a shame. I had held him in higher regard than that.
entries.I guess there are goblins living here. W: I suppose there are goblins living here. Well, that explains the lit torches.
entries.I hope Owaec hasn’t gotten into any trou: I hope Owaec hasn’t got into any trouble outside...
entries.Yes. We now look upon one of the most po: Yes. We now look upon one of the most powerful artefacts ever to taint Irdya. But first, we must clear out this room.
entries.What do we have here? This is what those: What do we have here? This is what those wyrms were grovelling about?
entries.Today I have been called shortsighted, t: Today I have been called short-sighted, then a coward, and now a deserter?! My honour will stand no more insult! Begone, foetid orc, lest I mount your head on a pike! I don’t fear the dead and I don’t fear you.
entries.I’m sure your commanders will come and s: I’m sure your commanders will come to save us!
entries.female^What? Didn’t you see those huge o: What? Didn’t you see those huge orcs drag them away? It’s hopeless!
entries.female^$deserter_name, I don’t recognize: $deserter_name, I don’t recognize you, and you look like you’ve been locked up longer than the rest of us. How did you get here?
entries.female^(scowling) A deserter. We should: (scowling) A deserter. We should lock you back in your cell.
entries.I’m already well-equipped, but we’ll hav: I’m already well-equipped, but we’ll have to pay upkeep to arm and armour each prisoner I free. I hope we’ll have enough gold left over for the next battle!
entries.Guess we’re on the run again! My mercena: Looks like we’re on the run again! My mercenary boys back home woulda made short work o’ these Whitefang punks... I sure am missin’ the Estmarks right about now.
entries.There is naught that I can speak that wo: There is nought that I can speak that would truly do them justice! You will have to see the plains yourself to appreciate their majesty.
entries.Then let us return quickly to Wesnoth to: Then let us return quickly to Wesnoth to aid in their defence!
entries.Aaah! Who’re you?! Run away run away!: Aaah! Who’re you?! Run away, run away!
entries.This looks like a disused mineshaft. I d: This looks like a disused mine-shaft. I don’t feel any fresh air, so we shouldn’t expect to escape this way.
entries.Gweddry and his men escaped from the orc: Gweddry and his men escaped from the orcish prisons and fled westwards as swiftly as they could, closely pursued by the orcs and their drake vassals.
At least you three commanders are safe. From here, you must ride swiftly, ride strong, and ride to save all of Wesnoth!
entries.(cough) And with the drakes defeated, (c: (cough) And with the drakes defeated, (cough)(cough) no enemies will be able to pursue us. Now, it is finally time for us to once again travel towards Weldyn.
entries.Long has our Honor been stained.\nNo lon:
Long has our Honour been stained.
No longer shall it be.
Now we reclaim our Eyrie,
And the strength of our Flight.
entries.Alas, my long days of riding have been f: Alas, my long days of riding have been for nought. I could not catch the undead scout before it could report back to its mistress!
entries.Wait a moment, can we talk about thi-: Wait a moment, can we talk about thi–
entries.More prisoners approach from the northwe: More prisoners approach from the north-west! I have not the time to depart and return with Gweddry, or those dwarves will surely be slain.
entries.We’re going as fast as we can! Maybe if: We’re going as fast as we can! Maybe if you’d let us swim–
My prisoners! You’ll pay for that...
entries.Anxious to rendezvous with the Wesnothia: Anxious to rendezvous with the Wesnothian army, Gweddry, Owaec, and Dacyn pressed hurriedly westwards. Their hearts sank as they passed battlefield after battlefield, in the ruins of what used to be Wesnoth’s thriving eastern provinces.
entries.... honor, glory, wealth... none of it s: ... honour, glory, wealth... none of it saved us in the end.
entries.Just more abominations for us to slay!!: Just more abominations for us to slay!
entries.We trusted you. I trusted you! Instead,: We trusted you. I trusted you! Instead, you sent us away from the war like cowards, led our men to slaughter at the hand of orcs and drakes, and deprived Wesnoth of her eastern guard when she needed it most sorely. And now my homeland has paid the price for your misdeeds!
entries.I’ve lost control of the Amulet! I must-: I’ve lost control of the Amulet! I must–
entries.But I will not despair! This damning des: But I will not despair! This damning destruction will not be the lasting legacy of the Clans! These undead will pay for the death they have brought!!!
entries.I agree, yet all is strangely quiet. Per:
I agree, yet all is strangely quiet. Perhaps the remaining undead lie dormant?

Even if we lack the strength to truly reclaim this place, we should still take the opportunity to gather what supplies remain. When finally we meet the shambling hordes responsible for all this destruction, we must not find our armouries wanting.
entries.<i>... we thought the enemy had erred, t: ... we thought the enemy had erred, that the battle could yet be won. Taking advantage of the gap, our swiftest riders drove towards the exposed heart of the skeletal formation. But even as they wrought destruction within the necromancers’ ranks, from out of the water came a great tremor, as if Irdya herself shivered in morbid anticipation. For a moment, I espied a great bony figure, a shambling mass of tooth and claw and wing. Then it fell upon us from behind, and the enemy closed their ranks, and we were encircled by death.
entries.<i>I fled, coward that I am, riding brea: I fled, coward that I am, riding breakneck through the night before my injuries overcame my strength. And so it comes that I have earned no honourable death in battle, only the slow fatigue and fever borne by rot and poison. I offer one final prayer to the Light, that at least my family may be spared and that my soul may be kept from undeath...
entries.Abomination!! Clansmen though you once w: Abomination! Clansmen though you once were, I have no choice but to grind you into dust now.
entries.Not sure what you’d call me anymore, but: Not sure what you’d call me any more, but definitely not more of a blight than you.
entries.Dacyn, I’ve been thinking. This artifact: Dacyn, I’ve been thinking. This artefact has had such a draining effect on you. Perhaps you should rest and take a moment to regain your strength? I could carry the Amulet for a while, or we could store it away.
entries.But on the other hand... this is a dange: But on the other hand... this is a dangerous artefact. I fear that only I can withstand its energies.
entries.Mage... I owe you an apology. This destr:
Mage... I owe you an apology. This destruction... even had we journeyed here instead of travelling north, we would most assuredly have made no difference. Of that I am now certain.

The fates may yet reveal that our journey north was necessary, even at such a steep cost. I will stand by you in this fight.
entries.I’m glad we have prevailed here, but I f: I’m glad we have prevailed here, but I fear greatly for Wesnoth if the Clans have been defeated so thoroughly so quickly. It has scant been a year since their invasion first began. Owaec, Dacyn, if you are prepared to travel, we must press towards Weldyn at once.
entries.Even this undead force appears to be (co: Even this undead force appears to be (cough) but a small fraction of Mal-Ravanal’s greater host. (cough)(cough) I must meet the king. Weldyn will fall if we do not act.
entries.If help was coming, we would have heard: If help was coming, we would have heard about it by now. They’re either unwilling or unable to march. What we need to consider is–
entries.My Liege, your former High Advisor Dacyn: My Liege, your former High Adviser Dacyn is here, and he says he has vital information on how to defeat the undead.
entries.You think we haven’t tried?! Our best ma: You think we haven’t tried?! Our best mages struck down that infernal lich at great cost to their number, but within seconds, Mal-Ravanal had already taken a new body and returned the favour on our ranks. I myself barely made it out alive!
entries.And that is why my companions and I have: And that is why my companions and I have spent the past year travelling far to the north-east, seeking (cough) a potent magical amulet that I now possess. If we can destroy the skeletal body, I wield the power to banish the lich’s long-tortured soul. This destruction will be permanent.
entries.You call Mal-Ravanal arrogant, yet you s: You call Mal-Ravanal arrogant, yet you seek to face such an overwhelming power in single combat? Even if you could claim victory with that foul amulet of yours, we cannot trust that lich to honour the terms of such a challenge. You would likely find yourself facing their entire army!
entries.Gweddry, do you recognize me? Do you rem: Gweddry, do you recognize me? Do you remember in the Estmarks, when you mercilessly cut down my defenceless sister? You escaped me once before, but now I will have my revenge!
Gweddry, do you recognize me? Do you remember in the Estmarks, when you mercilessly cut down my defenceless brother? I will kill you for what you have done.
entries.Konrad II will not leave the center isla: Konrad II will not leave the centre island.
entries.The southeastern bridges are secure; hos: The south-eastern bridges are secure; hostiles inbound.
My fortifications are manned and ready. Brace for attack from the south-west.
entries.Sire, you are of course welcome to captu: Sire, you are of course welcome to take any of my villages if you need them, but please know that it will make it more difficult to heal my injured soldiers.
entries.<i>Haldric the First, Dragonslayer, firs: Haldric the First, Dragonslayer, first King of Wesnoth.
entries.Finally, the gates creaked open once aga: Finally, the gates creaked open once again. Eyes looked on, eager, anxious, terrified, as the messenger rode towards the castle...
entries.A-ha haha! And how exactly do you plan t: A-ha ha ha! And how exactly do you plan to do that? Come now, you must know that you’re outmatched.
entries.The rules of the duel are these:\nYou ma:
The rules of the duel are these:
You may recruit or recall up to 6 units.
At the end of your first turn, your keep will disappear, and you must fight with whatever troops you have at that time.
entries.These liches are channeling some dark ma: These liches are channelling some dark magic to hide themselves. (cough)(cough) Even if Mal-Ravanal is here, I will not be able to (cough) reveal them until we have killed enough of these liches to break their spell. (cough)
entries.Stride fearless upon the plain of battle: Stride fearlessly upon the plain of battle, for today we reclaim our legacy! For Wesnoth!
entries.Then kill them we shall. Stride fearless: Then kill them we shall. Stride fearlessly upon the plain of battle, for today we reclaim our legacy! For Wesnoth!
entries.I knew Dacyn as a complicated man: ambit: I knew Dacyn as a complicated man: ambitious yet loyal, proud yet wise. But above all, Dacyn sought to act for the good of Wesnoth, and today we honour him for that.
entries.I had a mind to share this victory with: I had a mind to share this victory with those who made it possible, yet so many of them now lie dead. Lieutenant Gweddry, Lord Owaec, Adviser Dacyn, we thank you for your sacrifice.
entries.Grug, a necromancer ogre is something wh: Grug, a necromancer ogre is something wholly new to Us, but know that Wesnoth will never tolerate your kind. You shall surrender that accursed stave to be destroyed, you shall forswear the practice of all magic on penalty of death, and are hereby exiled from Wesnoth. Be grateful for Our mercy.
entries.Dolburras, Owaec has told me of the help: Dolburras, Owaec has told me of the help you provided his men; both your skill at arms and your tenacious spirit. We wish to offer you this finely crafted shield — an heirloom of my line — and an honour guard as you return to Knalga.
entries.Aye, I be honored. Ye have my sincerest: Aye, I be honoured. Ye have my sincerest thanks, yer Majesty.
entries.Aye, I be honored. I only wish he were h: Aye, I be honoured. I only wish he was here to see the Clans avenged.
entries.Mercenary, <i>necromancer</i>, know that: Mercenary, necromancer, know that Wesnoth will never tolerate your kind. You shall surrender that accursed stave to be destroyed, you shall forswear the practice of all magic on penalty of death, and you are hereby exiled from Wesnoth. Be grateful for Our mercy.
entries.Yeah, figures. How did I let myself get: Yeah, fine. How did I let myself get caught up in all this, anyway? Suppose I can always head north to those farmlands we passed by...
entries.Addogin, mercenary captain from the Estm: Addogin, mercenary captain from the Estmarks. I have heard the story of how you entered Gweddry’s service against your will, but I have also heard that you honoured your word to see this invasion through to its end. The palace could use a warrior of such calibre. We would offer you a position in the Royal Guard.
entries.Sir, uh, milord, uh, King sir, I’m honor: Sir, uh, milord, uh, King sir, I’m honoured, really am, but I just wanna go home. If it’s all right with you, this old geezer will be haulin’ himself back east, to an overdue retirement.
entries.Me, ambassador to the barbarian kingdoms: Me, ambassador to the barbarian kingdoms, what a thought! I am honoured, and would be even more honoured to learn that the job comes with... excellent pay I hope?
entries.It has been an honor to spread the holy: It has been an honour to spread the holy Light in this kingdom, and I humbly accept your commission. May the Light shine ever-bright upon the pious.
entries.As for you, <i>necromancer</i>. We are n: As for you, necromancer. We are not as like as Terraent to show mercy unto evil, but he speaks well of you, and so mercy shall be shown. Go from here a free woman, but know that you are hereby forbidden to practise magic in any form, at penalty of death.

As for you, necromancer. We are not as like as Terraent to show mercy unto evil, but in honour of his sacrifice We will show it now. Go from here a free woman, but know that you are hereby forbidden to practise magic in any form, at penalty of death.
entries.... as an adept I’d dreamt of one day st: ... as an adept I’d dreamt of one day standing in this palace, though under... different circumstances. Well, better that I get to keep my head, I suppose. I am grateful for Your leniency.
entries.And the same goes for you, wielder of th: And the same goes for you, wielder of that accursed stave. You shall surrender it to be destroyed, and leave here forbidden to practise magic. Be grateful for Our mercy.
entries.As for you, <i>necromancer</i>. You shal: As for you, necromancer. You shall surrender that accursed stave to be destroyed, and are hereby forbidden to practise magic in any form, at penalty of death. Be grateful for Our mercy.
entries.Okay, but that’s not really a battle pla: Okay, but that’s not really a battle pla–
entries.Reduce enemies to 0 hp to capture them a: Reduce enemies to 0 HP to capture them and gain gold. The prisons have limited space.
entries.What happened to dying slow? So much for: What happened to dying slowly? So much for him.
entries.We’ll never give in to you! For Wesnoth!: We’ll never give in to you! For Wesnoth!
entries.Keep pushing forward! Stick to the south: Keep pushing forwards! Stick to the south tunnels! We can do this!
entries.Get away from my jail cells! Filthy trai: Get away from my gaol cells! Filthy traitors, there goes my income...
entries.Fine then, I’m done taking prisoners. Fr: Fine then, I’m done taking prisoners. From here on, you either submit or die!
entries.But Chief, the necromancers already paid: But Chief, the necromancers already paid us! We can’t just–
entries.I tried being merciful. I tried working: I tried being merciful. I tried working towards peace. I tried building an empire where all races could be a part of something great, and all I asked in return was simple tribute.
entries.At the heart of each giant ant burrow li: At the heart of each giant ant burrow lies a queen. Much like their miniature cousins, a well-fed giant Ant Queen will continually lay eggs, ensuring that the colony never lacks workers for scavenging or soldiers for defence.
entries.The few lancers who survive for long eno: The few lancers who survive for long enough invariably find themselves commanding companies of their own. Still clad in minimal armour, they ride with even greater speed, charging into battle and leading from the forefront of any conflict.
entries.There are dark powers in this world whic: There are dark powers in this world which mankind was not meant to understand. Even the greatest and wisest can be bound in service of such a darkness.
entries.Once inexperienced, Gweddry is now a vet: Once inexperienced, Gweddry is now a veteran of many battles. His cunning and tactical skill enable him to direct even the freshest of recruits to strike strategically and emerge victorious. His skill with the longsword and crossbow is not to be underestimated either, nor is the speed with which he can move despite his heavy armour.
entries.Kings are trained rigorously in the comb: Kings are trained rigorously in the combat arts, sometimes out of necessity, more often out of tradition from when their priors made their wealth in war. Fitted in armour so skilfully made as to incite envy even from many dwarvish smiths, these sovereigns are well conditioned to their heavy armour and can manoeuvre across the battlefield much faster than their gilded plate would suggest.
entries.The leaders-to-be of the Horse Clans, ea: The leaders-to-be of the Horse Clans, each of these proud nobles is skilled in combat and adheres to a strict code of honour. Even the most tenacious of opponents will quake at the sight of a horse charge spearheaded by one of these fearless riders.
entries.The leaders of the naga have mastered th: The leaders of the naga have mastered the serpentine arts of their kind, striking faster than a lightning bolt and dancing away more gracefully than a forest brook. Undisputed masters of both swordsmanship and leadership, these naga are honoured by their clutch and bestowed the rare title of Centurion.
entries.This attack is exceptionally swift. When: This attack is exceptionally swift. When this attack is used on offence, the opponent will be unable to retaliate.
entries.The crushing power of this attack overwh: The crushing power of this attack overwhelms enemies. When used on offence, the opponent can only retaliate with one strike.
entries.This unit’s melee attack can overwhelm e: This unit’s melee attack can overwhelm enemies’ defences, preventing them from retaliating as effectively.
entries.It was perhaps as well for the men of Gw: It was perhaps as well for the men of Gweddry’s troop that they did not live to witness the fullness of the grim tide of undead sweeping westwards into Wesnoth, laying waste to all in its path.
entries.Their home country had proved to be no r: Their home country had proved to be no refuge for Gweddry’s weary men, and no more would it for the inhabitants of Wesnoth as foes pressed them on all sides to a final defence of the doomed kingdom.
entries.You are no savior of Man! Naught but a p: You are no saviour of Man! Nought but a pile of bones, a dead mage too stubborn to fall. Wesnoth will suffer you no longer!
entries.A-ha haha! You really thought you had a: A-ha ha ha! You really thought you had a chance there, didn’t you?
entries.Ha. Ah-ha, haha. Have it your way. I’ll: Ha. Ah-ha, ha ha. Have it your way. I’ll be seeing you soon.
entries.Was it for the good of Wesnoth when you: Was it for the good of Wesnoth when you enslaved the seer Eryssa’s senile mind, so the King would choose you as his adviser over Ravan?
entries.You misunderstand. This is no choice of:
You misunderstand. This is no choice of yours.

The stone bleeds your flesh. The darkness consumes your soul. Rebirth into undeath is the only path forwards to escape the Maw, else ye embrace oblivion.
entries.<span size='small'><i> This item is reu: This item is reusable if its wielder dies, and can be dropped by right-clicking. Picking up an item consumes your moves and attack.
entries.Eating this funny tasting meat <i><b>dou: Eating this funny tasting meat doubles your hit-points and grants immunity to cold.
entries.This goopy honey-like substance makes yo: This goopy honey-like substance makes you feel very sleepy... perhaps eating too much would be unwise. -1 damage, -1 movement, +10 hit-points.
entries.This incorporeal sword resembles those w: This incorporeal sword resembles those wielded by undead wraiths. Any mortal brave enough to wield it becomes chaotic and lashes out at their foes with reckless abandon. 6x4 arcane damage, drains, berserk. Always used on defence.
entries.This potion bubbles as though over an op: This potion bubbles as though over an open flame, yet is cool to the touch. Its drinker gains the steadfast ability and can heal 2 hit-points each turn, like dwarves with the ‘healthy’ trait.
entries.This plain gold ring looks unremarkable,: This plain gold ring looks unremarkable, but its wearer gains skirmisher and night-stalk, becoming invisible in the dark.
entries.Tempting! Most tempting... but I fear it: Tempting! Most tempting... but I fear it would be unwise for me to wield such a thing. That privilege passes on to another.
entries.No. I serve that which is good and light: No. I serve that which is good and light, and will not wield such a dark magical artefact.
entries.I will not wield such a dark magical art: I will not wield such a dark magical artefact, though I shall not begrudge its use by my companions.
entries.This shimmering blue vial grants its dri: This shimmering blue vial grants its drinker normal movement and defence in swamp and shallow water.
entries.An elixir of waterbreathing has given th: An elixir of water-breathing has given this unit normal movement and defence in swamp and shallow water.
entries.This saccharine green liquid grants +1 m: This saccharine green liquid grants +1 movement and +10% defence on all terrain. You may have difficulty standing still.
entries.An elixir of haste has given this unit +: An elixir of haste has given this unit +1 movement and +10% defence on all terrain.
entries.Fights normally during unfavorable times: Fights normally during unfavourable times of day/night
